correctness.rationale: Proof checks every q=m+1, k,m>=2, all allowed labelled seed assignments. At least m-1 vertices of each blade must be seeded. If hub seeded, every remaining blade vertex forces; if unseeded, no blade moves until hub is forced, which occurs exactly when its visible seeded neighbours contain all m other hues. For fixed proper full colouring exactly m seed patterns with one blank per blade omit the same hue and fail. Multiplication by (m+1)(m!)^k counts all unique successful completions once, yields exact formula. Random probability follows weighting each labelled seed, with polynomial equality including p=1/(m+1). Standalone independent integer brute enumerated 366142 starting assignments over seven small graphs plus 36 constructive domain pairs; finite checks not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The claim is a complete closed coefficient enumerator and exact random probability across the natural two-parameter generalized friendship / clique windmill family. The shared hub synchronizes colour omissions across blades, causing the essential m-term correction that a naïve product of clique formulas misses. It also yields a sharp exact minimum coloured-set size and its multiplicity on arbitrarily large clique bouquets. These are natural detailed benchmarks for the recently studied forced-colouring function, not an arbitrary small graph table or a restatement of k=1 complete graphs.
